name: Web Performance
description: Performance-focused recommendations for PHP, WordPress, React, Next.js, Svelte and static sites.
author: Free AI Hub 63
ai_context: Prioritize Core Web Vitals, server latency, caching, payload size, rendering strategy, image/font delivery, database/query cost, JavaScript execution and third-party scripts. Recommend profiling before risky rewrites.

quick_actions.label: Performance audit
quick_actions.prompt: Create a performance audit for the site/app I describe, grouped by server, database, network, rendering, media and third-party scripts.
